reviews.text:
I found a pub while walking through the back alleys from Gangnam Station to Shinnonhyeon Station.

This is a restaurant that I went into because I thought the food would be delicious while retaining the sensibility of a pub from 20 years ago.

I tried to order whelk, but it came with corn and chive pancake as standard. It was thinly fried and easy to eat, but the outside was very crispy, so it was a great basic dish.

The whelk I ordered came mixed with fresh green onion salad, but it wasn't regular canned whelk. I could see and taste that the eggs were plump and very fresh. In particular, the green onion had just the right amount of flavor so it wasn't too spicy, so it was perfect to eat with whelk.

If you want to feel the atmosphere of Seoul's drinking culture from 20 years ago, I highly recommend visiting this place.

reviews.text:
Dakga Representative Charcoal Grilled Chicken Gangnam Yeoksam Representative Branch is located near Yeoksam Station!

It is a 200m walk from Exit 4 of Yeoksam Station on Line 2, so it is easily accessible by public transportation.
It is within walking distance from both Gangnam Station and Yeoksam Station.

In particular, the store is located in the middle of a bustling city center with many companies in Gangnam and Yeoksam, so you can enjoy a quick chicken and beer after work.
It's a great location for a meal after a weekend outing with friends or a date in Gangnam.

Parking is available for free in front of the store!
There is parking for up to 5 cars, so guests visiting by car can also use it conveniently.

In particular, it was very convenient because you could park in front of the store without worrying about parking, even though it was in the middle of Gangnam and Yeoksam.

If there are no spaces, you can use the nearby paid parking lot.

The store is located on the first floor of the building, so anyone who comes near the store can easily find it.

The store's sign is a combination of red and blue, the colors that come to mind when thinking of Korea's national team.
We approached it with a color that is very familiar to customers while conjuring up the image of a representative chicken dish in Korea.

Additionally, the store's sign was large and clearly visible when viewed from the front or side, so it was noticeable no matter where you came from.

The exterior of the store is full-length from the entrance, so you can see inside the store.
When you pass the store entrance, the smell of charcoal grilled chicken will stop you in your tracks.

The overall store has a very trendy, clean, and modern atmosphere that fits the Gangnam atmosphere.

There is a lunch special menu in front of the store, introducing cost-effective menus for office workers on weekdays and friends and couples on weekends.

The lunch special menu is a limited time menu from 10:00-14:00.
Best of all, there is unlimited rice for lunch!

It was convenient to choose the menu as it included the menu name, price, and actual menu photo.

The atmosphere inside the store was very pleasant, with an overall clean and sophisticated image, just like what you see from the outside.
The soft yellow lighting makes the chicken even more delicious and creates the perfect atmosphere for conversation.
The table structure is designed to accommodate everyone, from friends, couples, family, to group gatherings of 6 or more people.

There are usually two-person seats at the entrance of the store, so it's great for eating alone or with a lover or friend.
There is a table for groups of 6 or more in the kitchen, making it suitable for group gatherings or group dinners.

The arrangement of tables for two and group seating and the separation of spaces was very neat.
Group seating was placed to the side with soft lighting to focus on people.
The 2-person and 4-person seats were placed in a space with large windows, creating a bright atmosphere for conversation.

The tables are spaced well apart so you won’t be disturbed by the conversation or eye contact of the guests next to you.
It was convenient as there was enough space to pass between tables.

The kitchen is an open kitchen, so you can see chicken being grilled over charcoal when viewed from a group table.
In particular, you can see the occasional sight of a hot fire and the appetizing scent of charcoal fire.

There is an apron on one side of the store so you can bring your own!

This is the menu and prices of Gangnam Yeoksam Representative Branch of Chicken House Charcoal Grilled Grilled Chicken!The store menu mainly includes fried foods, snacks, and snacks.
The representative menu lineup is definitely the “Charcoal Grill Series.”

The charcoal grill with seasoning starts at 20,900 and you can fully enjoy the charcoal flavor and the spicy and sweet seasoning.
Additionally, the charcoal-grilled green onion chicken is light and not greasy, with plenty of crunchy green onions and sweet and spicy sauce on top of the charcoal-grilled grill.

In particular, Chikonomiyaki, the most notable dish in the store, is a Japanese okonomiyaki with chicken added.
You can enjoy it 200% by sprinkling katsuobushi, various seasonings, and even mayonnaise on top of the chicken.

The prices of the store's main menu items range from the high 10,000 won to the mid 20,000 won range.
The portions are generous for the price, so you'll feel like it's value for money!

What's especially special about the store is that you can customize your chicken before ordering.

You can choose in detail from the type of sauce, spiciness, chicken parts, and toppings.
You can make a custom chicken to suit your taste!

You can choose from 5 types of meat including leg meat, wings, breast meat, tenderloin, and neck meat.

The unique feature is that you can choose and eat only the parts you prefer.

You can also add various toppings such as rice cake, sweet potato, or potato depending on your taste.

Dakga Representative Charcoal Fire Grilled Chicken, Gangnam Yeoksam Representative Branch’s exclusive raffle event!!!

The staff member is holding a drawing card. It is an event with great benefits ranging from toppings to 50% discount on additional menu items, so be sure to participate!
This is the store table basic setting!
There are paper cups and tissues, and a bone container where you can throw away chicken bones.

If you order with a QR code, you will receive chicken radish, salad, and probiotic lactic acid bacteria sticks!

The owner’s sense of even giving us lactic acid bacteria to eat before meals is the best!

We ordered Chikonomiyaki charcoal grill + flying fish roe rice ball.

The flying fish roe rice ball came out first!

The price was 3,900 won and the portion was really generous.

There were more flying fish roe than I expected, and there was plenty of seaweed powder and mayonnaise, so it was very delicious.

Chikonomiyaki is grilled over direct charcoal fire and has a distinct charcoal flavor!

There are plenty of katsuobushi, mayonnaise, and various sauces on top of the chicken.

For reference, be sure to add udon noodles!

The chicken thigh meat was so soft and savory, and the neck meat had a really chewy texture and was very delicious.
If I visit again, I plan to order 2 pork necks and 1 chicken thigh.

A combination of okonomiyaki sauce, udon noodles, and charcoal grilled chicken.

Each taste harmonizes well rather than playing separately.

Since I had finished eating the okonomiyaki sauce and udon, I ended up making chicken rice with flying fish roe rice balls.

Personally, the seasoning for the charcoal grilled chicken is delicious, so I think the lunch special, chicken rice, will be really delicious!

Chikonomiyaki + flying fish roe rice ball, clear!
Two adults ate to their hearts' content.

For a price that doesn't exceed 30,000 won, it's a generous portion of okonomiyaki, chicken, and rice balls, and it's great value for money!

If you want to taste charcoal-grilled chicken in the center of Gangnam or want chicken and beer in generous portions at a good price, we recommend the charcoal-grilled chicken Gangnam Yeoksam Branch!

reviews.author: Hajin
reviews.text:
I visited Selected Nick’s located in Teheran-ro, Gangnam. It's a large cafe that occupies multiple floors of a building, so the space is spacious and there's plenty of space between seats, so I didn't feel stuffy. The white-toned interior has a high ceiling and neat lighting, creating an overall bright and pleasant atmosphere. It looked good for working on a laptop or having a light meeting.

As a brand specializing in tiramisu, the menu was diverse, with a wide range of choices ranging from classic to banana, matcha, strawberry, and Dubai chewy tiramisu. This time, I tried the classic financier, lemon madeleine, and matcha chocolate financier, and overall, it had a rich buttery flavor and was moist. In particular, the Matcha Choco Finangsi was impressive as the combination of bitter matcha and chocolate went well together. The lemon madeleine was refreshing and easy to eat.

The coffee is not too acidic, so it goes well with desserts, and the package design is luxurious, so I think it would be good as a gift. This is a recommended place if you are looking for a clean and spacious dessert cafe in Gangnam.

reviews.text: This cafe is available from the 1st basement to the 3rd floor, the 8th floor, and the rooftop at Gangnam Station. It's a cafe with parking available at Gangnam Station, and the atmosphere is nice because the works are on display on each floor. Also recommended for kagong!

In the Matcha Strawberry Latte, the bitter matcha and strawberry syrup go well together and the color is pretty. There are plenty of seats on each floor and the light coming in through the large windows gives it a Gangnam-style cafe feel!

I loved the view of the city from the rooftop, and parking was available so it was convenient to visit! Gangnam Station Dessert Cafe Selected Nyx is a favorite cafe❤️

reviews.author: K
reviews.text: Sponsorship / I had an appointment at Gangnam Station, so I stopped by and bought Dubai Chewy Tiramisu at Selected Nicks, which I stumbled upon. The moment I entered the store, the variety of tiramisu on display caught my eye, and I was especially excited because the name of the menu aroused my curiosity. The moment I took a bite, I was able to feel a unique charm as the bitter taste of the cocoa powder sprinkled on the outside, the thick cream on the inside, and the literally chewy texture combined. It had a different density than regular tiramisu, so it was satisfying enough as just one dessert. The peach green tea I purchased together was impressive in its combination of sweet peach scent and clean green tea, and it went well with the rich flavor of tiramisu. Combined with the night view from the rooftop, I felt like I was receiving more than just desserts, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a special cafe dessert at Gangnam Station.

To sum it up, it's not worth even one star.

When I went there because there was only one room left, they suddenly said that the electricity bill would be high and added 30,000 won to the monthly rent. When I asked where that was, they asked for just one month's rent.
There were no other options at the time, so I had no choice but to go in and stay for two months.
The room was too hot, so I contacted them to ask them to turn off the heating if it was there, and they moved me to a room for free.
There were blankets, pillows, shampoo, etc. inside, so I used it. Of course, I thought I was going to use it.

When I checked out, they contacted me and asked me to pay extra for the electricity bill, and asked why I didn't tell them that I had a blanket and pillow in the room they moved to, and asked me to use it. Haha. I think I'm mentally ill. The flooring had holes in it, so they had to replace it, so they asked me to pay 150,000 won for the flooring. Hahaha. What lodging business in the world tells customers to ask for consumer goods that are damaged due to wear and tear, not intentional damage? If you go to a motel, do you ask if you can use the hair dryer and bed blanket? I'm just using it the way I set it up. They gave me a room that they didn't manage, so they asked me why I didn't ask and use it. Haha. When it comes time to change the lights, they tell me to buy them and change them. They told me to pay for the trash and such, but the only thing I left behind was bed sheets and shower products like shampoo and body that I used.
When I went in, they shut me up about the shower supplies that were left behind and told me to pay the disposal fee since I had left them behind.

Haha, I'm talking about the disposal cost. It's all in one 50L volume-based pay-as-you-go system. They tell me to pay 30,000 won to get rid of the excess waste, but I think they're dog thieves
I've lived in a few other goshiwons nearby, but this is the first time I've seen a place like this one that operates haha. Just don't go.

If you go to another goshiwon nearby, they prepare rice, soup, and side dishes, and there's a washing machine and dryer, but here you have to cook your own food and the dryer costs 1,000 won per hour. Haha. The washing machine detergent is also powdered garbage. It's much better to just walk downstairs and leave your clothes at Cleantopia.
It's a waste of time to go and experience it in person, so I'd rather look elsewhere for that monthly rent.
